sets.relationshipLabel: category and a kind of thing within it
sets.explanation: A rangefinder is a kind of camera, and a slide is a kind of film — each pair sets a broad category beside one of its members.

sets.relationshipLabel: smaller then larger version on one scale
sets.explanation: 35mm sits below medium format the way a postcard sits below a poster — each pair climbs the same size scale.

sets.relationshipLabel: first and last moments of a photographic process
sets.explanation: Loading opens a roll and rewinding closes it, just as developing begins a print and fixing seals it — each pair bookends one process.

sets.relationshipLabel: two things meeting at a shared boundary
sets.explanation: A subject sits against its backdrop and an image sits inside its frame — each pair is defined by the edge where one meets the other.
